title: DANGEROUS MIDNIGHT PRAYERS FOR UNSTOPPABLE FAVOUR AND DIVINE ACCELERATION
text: Welcome to the watch. While the world sleeps, the generals are awake. While the ordinary man is dreaming, the spiritual man is legislating. Hear me. Midnight is not just [music] a time on the clock. It is a spiritual coordinate. It was at midnight that the firstborn [music] of Egypt were struck. It was at midnight that Paul and Silas sang until the foundations of the prison shook. It was at midnight that the bridegroom came. If you want to change your day, you must control your night. We're not here to play. We're here to engage dangerous prayers. Prayers that shift territories. Prayers that provoke unstoppable favor. Prayers that trigger divine acceleration. Are you ready to take back your destiny? I open your spirit to Psalm 102:13. You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for the time to favor her. Yes, the set time has come. There is a time called the [music] set time. In Greek, we call it kairos. It is when the accumulated prayers of the saints collide with the mercy of God to produce a sudden shift. Some of you have been in chronos time, natural time, for too long. Waiting for 20 years to get a promotion. Waiting for 10 years to get married. Tonight, we are shifting you from chronos to kairos. We are compressing time. Before we ask for speed, we must ask for mercy. Speed in the wrong direction is a disaster. And if there is any sin, any weight, any accusation standing against you in the courts of heaven, we must silence it with the blood. Lift your voice from the [singing and music] depth of your belly and cry, "Lord, show me mercy. Let the blood of Jesus speak for me at this midnight hour. Any legal right the enemy has to delay my destiny, I cancel it by mercy. I step out of judgment and [music and singing] I step into grace." There is a spirit called the spirit of Kadesh Barnea. It is the spirit of near success syndrome. It is the spirit that kept Israel wandering in a circle for 40 years for a journey that should have taken 11 days. That is the opposite of acceleration. That is stagnation. Some of you are moving, but you are not making progress. You are on a rocking chair. Tonight, we break THAT YOKE. FIRE THIS PRAYER like a missile. You spirit of stagnation, LOOSE ME NOW. I BREAK THE CYCLE of moving in circles. Every demonic chain tied to my ankles to keep me in the same spot, break by fire. I am not a victim of delay. I am a candidate for speed. The prophetic decree activating favor. Now, we speak to favor. Favor is not money. Favor is the currency that buys money. When favor is on you, one day of your life is worth a thousand years of labor. Exodus 3:21, "And I will give these people favor in the sight of the Egyptians." I want you to visualize your workplace, your business, your family. We're going to command a cloud of favor to descend. Declare with me, "I put on the garment of favor. I command the hearts of kings to lose sleep until they bless me. I DECREE THAT MY NAME is sweet in the mouths of my helpers. Where I was rejected yesterday, I shall be celebrated tomorrow." The impartation of speed. 1 Kings 18:46, "Then the hand of the Lord came upon Elijah, and he girded up his loins and ran ahead of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel." Ahab had a chariot. Elijah had the hand of God. The supernatural will always overtake the natural. Receive this prophecy. I decree divine speed. Recover 10 years in 1 year. Recover lost assets. Recover lost relationships. Overtake those WHO WENT AHEAD OF YOU. We have engaged the gears. The engine is running. The spirit of delay is broken, but now we must direct this favor. We need to target specific areas of your life, your finances and your status. Welcome back to the firing line. We have dealt with the atmosphere of speed. Now, we must address the fuel for the vehicle. We must deal with resources. Please hear me and hear me well. Poverty is not a virtue, it is a destruction. A man who is worried about his next meal cannot focus on his kingdom assignment. The devil uses lack as a weapon to silence your voice and bury your potential. Ecclesiastes 9:16 says, "The poor man's wisdom is despised and his words are not heard." Tonight, we are not asking for money for vanity. We are asking for the power to get wealth. Deuteronomy 8:18, so that we can finance the end-time agenda. We are here to command the earth to yield its increase. Are you ready to break the backbone of lack in your lineage? Break it. Poverty is not just an economic condition. It is a spiritual [music] atmosphere. There is a spirit that makes a man walk like an elephant and eat like an ant. There is a spirit that pokes holes in your pocket. We're going to judge that spirit right now. I want you to get angry in your spirit. Lift your voice and pray this dangerous prayer. You spirit of poverty assigned to MY FATHER'S HOUSE, DIE. I reject the mantle of lack. I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places. There is money that is hidden. There are resources that are locked up waiting for a decree. There are people holding your money right now. We're going to command a transfer. Declare with authority. I command the hidden riches of secret places, find me. You gates of FINANCIAL FAVOR, OPEN BY FIRE. I call forth my helpers. I call forth my investors. I call forth my customers. North, south, east, west, release my portion. Malachi 3:11, "And I will rebuke the devourer for your sake." The devourer is the spirit of emergency expenses. The car breaks down. The sickness comes. The theft happens. It is the spirit that ensures you never have savings. Tonight, we arrest him. Raise your hand as a shield and shout, "I rebuke the devourer. I cover my finances with the blood of Jesus. No more leakage. No more wastage. No more loss. I DECREE THAT MY STOREHOUSE SHALL be full." Prophetic act. The anointing of hands. I want you to look at your hands. These hands are the instruments of your destiny. If your hands are cursed, your labor is in vain. If your hands are blessed, you touch dust and it turns to gold. I am releasing the mantle of kingdom finance upon your hands right now. Receive it. I bless these hands. They shall handle millions for the kingdom. They shall sign global contracts. They shall build houses and plant vineyards. I activate the Midas touch of the spirit, prosperity with peace. It is settled. The yoke is broken. The devourer is silenced. The supply is released. But listen to me. Having money is one thing. Having the wisdom to keep it and the excellence to multiply it is another. The devil often steals from Christians through the spirit of mediocrity and bad decisions. We are not done. We must secure your mind for high-level functioning. Go and prosper. We have prayed for speed. We have prayed for money. But please, lend me your spirit. Favor brings you into the palace, but only excellence keeps you there. If God gives you a billion dollars today, but you have the mind of a pauper, you will lose it in a month. If God gives you a platform, but you lack the spirit of excellence, you will embarrass heaven. Many believers are praying for open doors, but they are not preparing for what is behind the door. Mediocrity is a spirit. It is the voice that says it is good enough. It is the voice that says manage it like that. God does not manage. God excels. Daniel distinguished himself because an excellent spirit was found in him. Tonight, we are killing the spirit of average. We are upgrading your mental operating system. Upgrade me. The warfare rebuking the spirit of mediocrity. Mediocrity makes you invisible. Excellence makes you indispensable. The spirit of mediocrity is often a generational curse where almost is the family motto. We almost finished school. We almost built the house. That stops today. Lift your voice and pray this prayer of separation. I reject the spirit of mediocrity. I curse the spirit of laziness and procrastination. I refuse to be average. I refuse to be ordinary. Every mental blockade preventing me from thinking at a global level, scatter. The Bible says, "But we have the mind of Christ." That means you have access to the intelligence that created the universe. You should not be the confused one in your office. You should not be the one without ideas in the boardroom. When you show up, solutions should show up. We're going to download divine strategy. Put your two hands on your head. This is your command center. Declare, "I activate the mind of Christ in me. I receive witty inventions and creative ideas. I call forth solutions to difficult problems. I am 10 times better than [music and singing] my peers like Daniel." ministration the mantle of value Listen to me. The world does not pay for time. It pays for value. If you want unstoppable favor, become so valuable that ignoring you is impossible. There is an anointing that puts a spotlight on your skill. It makes your small business look like a multinational corporation. It makes your ministry look like it is backed by angels because it is. I prophesy over your work, your career, receive the spirit of excellence. Let the quality of your work announce you to kings. I rebuke errors. I rebuke mistakes. I rebuke forgetfulness. From today, you will be known for distinction. prophetic act the Joseph anointing Joseph came out of the prison because he had the solution to Pharaoh's dream. His gift made room for him. There is a problem in your city, in your industry, waiting for you to solve it. I pray for you now. May the problem that will announce your destiny locate you. May the answer be placed in your spirit this very night. Go from the prison to the palace by the power of excellence. You are now sharp. You are now precise. You have the favor, the resources, and the mindset, but there is one enemy left. The enemy that watches you rise and tries to pull you down. [music] Two words, slander and legal accusations. We need to silence the accuser. We need to deal with the voices speaking against your rising. Go and be excellent. Welcome to the Supreme Court of the universe. We have dealt with speed. We have dealt with money. We have dealt with excellence, but there is a reason many of you are still experiencing resistance at the edge of breakthrough. It is because the devil is not just a roaring lion. The Bible calls him the accuser of the brethren. He knows he cannot defeat God's power, so he challenges God's justice. He stands in the courts of heaven and points a legal finger at your bloodline, your past mistakes, and your broken vows. He says, "God, you cannot bless him. He is guilty. He has an unpaid debt." This is why you pray and fast, yet the door remains closed. It is a legal injunction, but tonight, we have an advocate, Jesus Christ the righteous. We're going to enter the courts of heaven and obtain a verdict of acquittal. Are you ready to silence the voice that speaks against your destiny? Zechariah 3 shows us Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord and Satan [music] standing at his right hand to oppose him. Joshua was anointed, but he was wearing filthy garments. The accusation was valid, but God's mercy overruled. We're going to enter our plea. Do not plead innocent. You are not innocent on your own. Plead the blood. Lift your hands and present your evidence. Father, I approach the courts of heaven tonight. I do not come in my own righteousness. I come by the blood of Jesus. I silence EVERY ACCUSER STANDING AT MY right hand to resist my promotion. I plead the blood of the eternal covenant against every record of sin in my lineage. Isaiah 54:17 says, "Every tongue which rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn." Notice, God won't condemn it for you. You shall condemn it. There are people speaking against you in offices right now. There are altars speaking against you from your village. There are words you spoke against yourself in moments of frustration. We expunge them from the record. Open your mouth and legislate. I OBJECT TO EVERY SATANIC decree issued AGAINST MY LIFE. EVERY TONGUE saying he will not rise, she will NOT MARRY, I CONDEMN YOU. I ERASE every negative word written in the spirit realm concerning my future. Let the lying lips be put to silence. I nullify every demonic covenant holding me ransom. I am free. prophetic verdict the change of raiment In Zechariah 3:4, after the accuser was silenced, the angel said, "Take away the filthy garments from him. See, I have removed your iniquity from you, and I will clothe you with rich robes." The filthy garment is the garment of shame, rejection, and past failure. The rich robe is the garment of favor and royalty. Tonight, a wardrobe change is happening in the spirit. Receive this prophecy. I command the garment of shame to catch fire. I command the garment of rejection to fall off your body. Receive the royal robe of favor. Receive the turban of dignity. Where you were despised, you shall now be honored. Change my raiment, Lord. The judgment against the adversary. The court is ruling in your favor. But what about the enemy who wasted your time? The law of restitution must apply. Proverbs 6:31 says, "If the thief [music] is found, he must restore sevenfold." Declare your restoration. Devil, you have been found guilty. Take your hands off my case. I demand sevenfold restoration for every year wasted. I walk out of this courtroom justified, glorified, and accelerated. It is finished. The gavel has fallen. Who shall lay a charge against God's elect? It is God who justifies. You are cleared for takeoff. No spiritual barrier can hold you down anymore. But now that you are cleared, and you have speed, and you have favor, you need preservation. The higher you go, the windier it gets. You need to ensure that you live long enough to enjoy this blessing. We must seal this series with the seal of long life and divine immunity. Go with your verdict. Beloved, we have arrived at the final seal. We have secured your speed. We have secured your wealth. We have secured your excellence. We have secured your verdict, but there is one final tragedy we must prevent. Ecclesiastes 6:2 speaks of a man to whom God has given riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing, yet God does not give him power to eat of it, but a foreigner consumes it. This is vanity. What is the profit of acceleration if you crash at the finish line? What is the profit of favor if you are not alive to enjoy it? The enemy knows he cannot stop the blessing, so he attacks the vessel. He targets your life, your health, and your longevity. But tonight, we establish the covenant of exemption. We are drawing a line in the sand against the spirit of death. Are you ready to secure your long life? Open your mouth and declare the constitution of your existence. Psalm 118:17, "I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord." Death is not just a biological event. It is a spirit that tries to truncate destiny. It comes through accidents. It comes through sudden organ failure. It comes through stray bullets, but we have a superior [music] decree. Lift your right hand to the heavens and shout, "I shall not die, but live. My family shall not die, but live. I reject every appointment with premature death. I will fulfill the number of my days in strength and vitality." Paul said, "From now on, let no one trouble me, for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus. In the realm of the spirit, there is a mark of exemption. When the angel of death sees it, he must pass over. It is the same mark that was in Egypt. It is the same mark in Ezekiel 9. I want you to spiritually place this mark on your forehead right now. Touch your forehead. I receive the mark of exemption. I declare that I am touch not to the powers of darkness. Sickness, when you see me, pass over. Kidnappers, when you see me, PASS OVER. RITUAL KILLERS, WHEN you see me, pass over. I am dangerous to touch. Warfare, breaking the pattern of suddenly. We need to pray against the spirit of suddenly. Suddenly, they collapsed. Suddenly, the car crashed. We rebuke sudden tragedy. Pray this dangerous prayer. I destroy the agenda of sudden calamity. Every trap set for my feet on the highway, catch fire. I cause the spirit of hereditary disease, it stops with me. I shall not be a victim of another man's error. Men. Now, people of God, lift your hands. I stand over your life, over your destiny, over your household. We have traveled through the watches of the night, and now I seal these prayers. By the power that raised Jesus from the dead, I launch you into your season of acceleration. I command the doors of favor to remain open. I command the devourer to stay far from your dwelling. I command the accuser to be silent forever. I command life, health, and peace to be your daily bread. Go and succeed. GO AND PROSPER. GO AND OVERTAKE. The Lord is with you. It is done. In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost. Amen. We thought we were finished, but the Holy Ghost is beckoning us deeper. We have prayed for speed, we have prayed for favor, but Psalm 11:3 asked a dangerous question. If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do? Hear me. You can have an engine for speed, but if you are tied to a stake, you will only make noise, not movement. Many of you are running fast, but you are running on a treadmill. Why? Because of foundations. Because of ancient gates. There are spiritual gates in your bloodline that say, "No one crosses this limit. No one stays married past 5 years. No one builds a house BEFORE 50. NO ONE RISES TO THE global stage." These are not just habits, they are demonic checkpoints. Tonight, we are not negotiating with them. We are shattering them. We are taking the battle to the root. Are you ready to pull down the ancient strongholds? The psalmist understood spiritual architecture. HE DIDN'T JUST PRAY TO GOD, he spoke to the gates. Psalm 24:7, "Lift up your heads, oh you gates, and be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in." Notice they are called everlasting doors. They have been there for generations. They stopped your grandfather, they stopped your father, but they will not stop you. Lift your voice like thunder and command the gates to open. LIFT UP YOUR HEADS, OH YE ANCIENT gates of my lineage, YOU EVERLASTING DOORS SHUTTING OUT MY GLORY, CRASH OPEN NOW. I command THE KING OF GLORY TO ENTER MY FAMILY. EVERY GATEKEEPER STANDING AT THE BORDER of my breakthrough, give way. The warfare, dealing with the bloodline altars. Gideon could not save Israel until he tore down his father's altar. Some of you are trying to build a skyscraper on a foundation dedicated to idols. The favor we prayed for in part one cannot rest on a cursed foundation. We are sending fire to the root, to the village, to the coven, to the shrine. Pray this with holy anger. I locate the altar speaking against my rising. Blood of Jesus, visit my foundation. Every covenant my ancestors made with idols that is claiming my destiny, I break it. I am a new creation. I have a new bloodline. I disconnect from the failure of my fathers. There is something called a satanic limit. It is an invisible ceiling. You rise to a certain salary and you lose your job. You get to a certain level of happiness and a crisis happens. That is the limit. Tonight, by the power of the Holy Ghost, we are crossing it. I command the glass ceiling TO SHATTER. I EXCEED THE LIMITS OF MY LINEAGE. Where my father stopped, I START. WHERE MY MOTHER FAILED, I SUCCEED. I PROPHESY. I am the pattern breaker of my family. I want to pray for the first-timers. The first to be a millionaire in the family. The first to have a happy marriage. The first to travel the nations. It is hard to be the first. You are the icebreaker. The resistance is heaviest on you, but I release the mantle of the pioneer upon you. Deuteronomy 1:11, "May the Lord God of your fathers make you a thousand times more numerous than you are, and bless you as he has promised you." Receive the grace to build a new foundation. I decree that you are the Abraham of your lineage. The curse stops with you. The blessing starts with you. I am the Abraham. The gates are lifted. The foundation is purged. You are now free to run without a rope tied to your waist. But there is one final dimension of midnight warfare. After the prayer comes the prophecy. Ezekiel prophesied to dry bones and they became an army. You need to learn how to prophesy your week, your month, and your year into alignment. We will conclude this extended session. We do not go anywhere. We are finishing strong. Welcome to the womb of time. We have fought the past, we have secured the present, but a king does not just react to today. A king determines tomorrow. Please listen to me. Prophecy is not just prediction, prophecy is creation. When God wanted light, he did not wait for it, he spoke it. Romans 4:17 says, "God calls those things which do not exist as though they did." You are standing at the edge of your future right now. It is blank, it is void, it is formless. The devil wants to fill it with tragedy, the economy wants to fill it with inflation, but we are going to fill it with glory. Are you ready to write the history of your life before it happens? The mystery of programming time. Job 38:12 asked, "Have you commanded the morning since your days began and caused the dawn to know its place?" Time has ears. The week has ears. The month has ears. If you are silent, time will just repeat the cycles of your past. But if you speak, time becomes a servant that delivers your desires. We are going to program the next season of your life. I want you to speak with the authority of a commander. Lift your hand and speak into the week ahead. I speak to the next 7 days. You shall not carry any bad news. I command Monday to open [music] doors for me. I command Friday to end with a testimony. I decree that every appointment this week is fixed in my favor. The world predicts recession, we predict expansion. Isaac sowed in the land of famine and reaped a hundredfold. Why? Because he [music] carried a different climate. Prophesy over your economy. I exempt myself from the economic crunch of the nations. I speak to my bank account, be fruitful and multiply. I speak TO MY BUSINESS, ATTRACT high-paying clients. I decree that money is failing in the hands of the wicked and finding its way to my hands. The enemy tries to project sickness into the future. By age 50, you will have arthritis. By October, the flu will come. No, we cancel the appointment. I [music] speak to my future self. I shall be stronger next year than I am today. I cancel every hospital admission programmed into my calendar. I prophesy, divine health is my heritage from January to December. The Ephphatha cry, opening the womb of destiny. Mark 7:34, "Then looking up to heaven, he sighed and said to him, 'Ephphatha,' that is, 'Be opened.'" There is a version of you that the world has not seen yet. A version of you that is fearless. A version of you that is wealthy, a version of you that is anointed. It is trapped in the womb of time. Command it to come forth. Ephphatha, be opened. My destiny, come forth. My global influence, come forth. My kingdom marriage, come forth. I am not who I used to be. I am shifting levels right now. Final seal, the apostolic benediction on the series. We have come to the end of the midnight watch, but your life has just begun. You have engaged the mysteries of the kingdom. You have prayed dangerous prayers. Now, as you go to sleep or as you step into your day, walk with the consciousness that heaven has heard you. The spiritual legislation is passed. The angels have been dispatched. The earth is realigning. I bless you with the blessing of the Lord that adds no sorrow. I bless you with speed. I bless you with favor. I bless you with long life. Go and become a sign and a wonder to your generation. Shalom. >> [music]
